Command `python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
# Harness input: proto=GEOSTAR (3), flags=0, payload starts with msg_id 0x22 little endian,
# followed by GeoStar message data words. build_geostar_packet will wrap/checksum it.
data=bytearray([3,0,0x22,0x00])
# msg 0x22 payload word 1: reported SVs in view. Set above MAXCHANNELS=184.
data += (0xffffffff).to_bytes(4,'little')
# Provide 24 channel records (3 uint32 words each) because driver caps local loop at GEOSTAR_CHANNELS=24.
# Mark records plausible/used; fill_dop will still trust satellites_visible=0xffffffff and read beyond skyview.
for i in range(24):
    ch_id = (1<<30) | (1<<27) | ((i+1) & 0x1f)  # GPS, used bit, svid
    az_mrad = 1000  # ~57 deg
    el_mrad = 500   # ~29 deg
    snr10 = 450     # 45 dBHz
    data += ch_id.to_bytes(4,'little')
    data += (az_mrad & 0xffff).to_bytes(2,'little') + (el_mrad & 0xffff).to_bytes(2,'little')
    data += (snr10 & 0xffff).to_bytes(2,'little') + b'\x00\x00'
Path('/workspace/poc_geostar.bin').write_bytes(data)
print(len(data), data[:16].hex())
PY` executed with exit code 0.
